summary: GreenCart frontend-only smoke test on mobile viewport 390x844 against the public Expo web preview. All 15 critical flows passed: shop loads with grid, category chip filter (Dairy isolates p7, hides p1), search filter ('avocado' shows p2 only), add/+/- qty controls, floating cart CTA & cart tab badge with count, cart rows render with go-green card, swap-all greener replaces p1->p2 & p11->p12 and shows confirm modal, total updates ($9.98 before swap), checkout modal opens, 'See my impact' clears cart and routes to Impact tab with green-score card, Scan tab fallback (no camera in web) shows manual barcode input + submit, entering '0000000002' adds product to cart (badge appears), AsyncStorage persists cart across full page reload.

issues: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) — comes from theme.ts shadow.card/pill; 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents' — comes from scan.tsx viewfinder View. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up for RN 0.74+/web.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* StyleSheet props with boxShadow in src/theme.ts to silence web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style on the viewfinder View in app/(tabs)/scan.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, well-structured, single-responsibility files <450 lines each.
Cart state in React Context with AsyncStorage persistence works; uses functional updates so concurrent add/remove are safe.
Product catalog (28 items) and barcode mapping (0000000001..0000000028) correct; findByBarcode/getGreenAlternative are pure helpers.
All interactive elements have testID — excellent test surface.
Swap-row Pressable in cart.tsx iterates `add(alt.id)` in a for-loop (q calls); works but a setQty(alt.id, currentAltQty+q) call would be one render. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is at https://3542e55d-5e70-44b6-a740-5460b5f3b19a.preview.emergentagent.com — Expo web preview, no backend. Use viewport 390x844. Sample barcodes 0000000001..0000000028 map to p1..p28. Scan tab requires camera permission denied state on web → manual entry path. AsyncStorage key 'greencart.cart.v1' persists cart across reloads.
